inputs.text: The subject is a young woman, appearing to be in her twenties, with a medium complexion and an oval face shape that is slightly narrower at the chin. She is wearing a dark, long-sleeved top and a red scarf draped around her neck and over her left shoulder. Her gaze is directed straight at the camera. The composition is a close-up portrait, with the subject positioned slightly off-center to the right, filling most of the frame.
